title: Agency commands carried
what: agent, model, coworker, worker fold, run list and stop, reload, the node and dev-server verbs, companion follow and reset and claude batch handed to bmo-agency; agent --pause-keepalive asks the cache warmer. Lives in src/carriers/agency.rs.

title: Artifact commands carried
what: archive doc, share and html-read, search, search branch and runner search handed to bmo-artifact-cli under the same words, the road only to the search and its runner. Lives in src/carriers/artifact.rs.

title: Brain commands carried
what: memory, note, fragment, the digests, brain hold and wait, reminder list and the watches asked of bmo-brain routes, as the agent named or the turn agent. Lives in src/carriers/brain.rs.

title: Carried commands and their reach
what: The modules carrying a unit command words: the Carried trait they register through inventory, the cli settings with each unit address and token, the turn read as agency tools read it, and one HTTP call over a port or a Unix socket.

title: bmo command dispatch
what: The thin entry point bmo: finds the bmo-<name> unit commands beside it and on PATH, reads and caches their nouns, resolves a command by declared noun, carried module or git rule, and hands it on or answers it. Lives in src/lib.rs and src/resolve.rs.

title: Home bridge client
what: A home-bound command asked on a work node is handed whole to the operations machine over the socket BMO_HOME_BRIDGE names, and its relayed output and exit code are the run. Lives in src/bridge.rs.

title: Node commands carried
what: node list and node hardware handed to bmo-node as node and hardware-setup after the configuration file the cli settings name. Lives in src/carriers/node.rs.

title: Room sends carried
what: room say, photo, react, pin and sticker, draw draw and reminder set asked of the receiver POST /sends, and consult say and state of its consult routes, as the turn agent. Lives in src/carriers/receiver.rs.

title: Testbed commands carried
what: test suite, count, log, template and full, check, imports, cargo and deploy commit and backups handed to bmo-testbed under the verb its boundary documents. Lives in src/carriers/testbed.rs.

title: Tool catalogue commands
what: tool list, describe, call and sites asked of the tool host control socket: GET /catalogue, POST /calls under a shell record, GET /facts/web. Lives in src/carriers/pocket.rs.
